operations.name: health
operations.description: Liveness check (PocketBase built-in).

operations.name: ops.list
operations.description: Return this operations manifest.

operations.name: app.guide
operations.description: START HERE: who you are on the team, the model (boards, columns as contracts, assignees: people, agents and the pool, requesters, agent states, reviews), the work protocol (work.next, heartbeat, submit, ask, return, fail), the rules agents are held to, error codes, and the boards with who works each column.
operations.label: Guide

operations.name: app.status
operations.description: The team's agents at a glance (each one's status, cards it works and waiting for it), whether every agent is paused, how many people are online, how many cards wait on people, and (for an agent) where you stand.
operations.label: Status

operations.name: app.state
operations.description: What the app frame shows, in one call: you, the workspace settings, boards with live counts, the people (online, where) and the agents (working, waiting, idle, paused), and the cards that need you (reviews, questions, attention, proposals) with the team's totals.
operations.label: App state

operations.name: app.context
operations.description: What the people online are looking at, the most recent first, with that person's open board and card.
operations.label: On screen

operations.name: app.ui
operations.description: The app reports where the signed-in person is (used by the app itself for presence; app.context reads it).
operations.label: Report screen

operations.name: settings.get
operations.description: The workspace: its name, how new accounts join (open or admin approval), whether every agent is paused, how many cards an agent works at once by default.
operations.label: Settings

operations.name: settings.update
operations.description: People: pause or resume every agent (any member). Admins: the workspace name, how new accounts join, the default cards an agent works at once, defaults for new columns.
operations.label: Change settings

joining.description: New accounts: open (in at once) or approval (an admin lets them in)

paused.description: Pause every agent (claims, heartbeats and writes are refused)

max_working.description: Cards each agent works at once by default, across its sessions (1..10, default 2)

operations.name: me.get
operations.description: The caller: a person's account (name, colour, role, status, inbox preferences), or for an agent, its own entry (status, limit, cards it works).
operations.label: My account

operations.name: me.update
operations.description: The person: your display name, avatar colour and inbox preferences (what interrupts you, what waits in the inbox or the digest; whether the inbox opens on your cards or everyone's).
operations.label: Change my account

prefs.description: JSON {"attention":{"reviews","questions","attention","updates"}: each interrupt, inbox or digest, "inbox":"mine"|"all"}

operations.name: people.list
operations.description: The team's members: name, email, role, status, online and where, open cards assigned to them. Admins also see accounts waiting to join and suspended ones.
operations.label: People

operations.name: people.update
operations.description: Admins: let a waiting account in (status active), suspend or restore a member, make someone an admin or a member. You cannot change your own role or status, and the workspace keeps at least one admin.
operations.label: Change member

operations.name: agents.list
operations.description: Every agent on the team, live: status (working, waiting, idle, paused), the cards it works now, how many wait for it, its limit, when it was last seen, and its report card over the last days.
operations.label: Agents

days.description: Report card window in days (1..90, default 7)

operations.name: agents.update
operations.description: People: pause or resume one agent (any member). Admins: rename it, recolour it, set how many cards it works at once (0 = the workspace default), bring a removed agent back.
operations.label: Change agent

paused.description: Paused: it takes no cards and its writes are refused

max_working.description: Cards at once (0 = workspace default, up to 10)

operations.name: agents.remove
operations.description: Admins: remove an agent from the team. Cards it works or holds go back to the pool (or to nobody), columns it worked go to any agent. It is refused if it calls again, until restored.
operations.label: Remove agent
operations.confirm: Remove this agent from the team?

operations.name: boards.list
operations.description: Boards with their key, how-we-work instructions, frozen flag and live counts (cards, agents working, queued, waiting on people).
operations.label: Boards

operations.name: boards.get
operations.description: A board with its columns (each column's contract: category, WIP, policy, who works it, gates, next, lease) and its cards (key, title, column, priority, labels, assignee, requester, agent state, review state, blocked, age) and labels.
operations.label: Board

full.description: Include each card's description, acceptance criteria, checklist and review

operations.name: boards.templates
operations.description: Starting points for a new board: simple, agent pipeline, content studio, software, three columns.
operations.label: Board templates

operations.name: boards.create
operations.description: People: create a board from a template.
operations.label: New board

key.description: Card key prefix (2 to 6 letters or digits, e.g. OPS); default from the name

instructions.description: How we work: standing instructions every agent run receives

operations.name: boards.update
operations.description: People: rename, change the key or description, the how-we-work instructions, freeze (agents cannot change the board), swimlanes, archive.
operations.label: Change board

frozen.description: Frozen: agents cannot change anything on this board

operations.name: boards.delete
operations.description: Admins: delete a board with its columns, cards, labels, rules and activity.
operations.label: Delete board
operations.confirm: Delete this board and everything on it?

operations.name: columns.add
operations.description: People: add a column (a stage with its contract).
operations.label: Add column

category.description: What the column means: triage (agent proposals), backlog, todo, doing, review (waits for a person), done, canceled

wip.description: WIP limit (0 = none): binding for agents, a warning for people

policy.description: Entry and exit policy shown in the column header

instructions.description: Instructions an agent receives when it works here

agent_mode.description: Who works the column: off (people), any (every card that enters goes to the pool, any agent takes it) or one (every card that enters goes to the agent named in agent). To-do and started columns only.

agent.description: The one agent that works this column (handle or name; sets agent_mode one). Empty clears it.

plan_first.description: An agent posts a plan a person approves before it works

need_criteria.description: Cards need acceptance criteria before an agent takes them

need_checklist.description: Cards leave this column only with every checklist item ticked (binding for agents)

next.description: The column work goes to when an agent submits (default: the next column)

return_to.description: Review columns: where Request changes sends the card (default: the column it was worked in)

lease_minutes.description: How long a claim holds without a heartbeat (2..240, default 15)

max_attempts.description: Tries before the card needs a person (1..10, default 3)

aging_days.description: Flag cards older than this many days here (0 = from the board's history)

operations.name: columns.update
operations.description: People: change a column's contract. Handing it to agents (or another agent) queues the cards already there, except cards assigned to a person.
operations.label: Change column

category.description: What the column means: triage (agent proposals), backlog, todo, doing, review (waits for a person), done, canceled

wip.description: WIP limit (0 = none): binding for agents, a warning for people

policy.description: Entry and exit policy shown in the column header

instructions.description: Instructions an agent receives when it works here

agent_mode.description: Who works the column: off (people), any (every card that enters goes to the pool, any agent takes it) or one (every card that enters goes to the agent named in agent). To-do and started columns only.

agent.description: The one agent that works this column (handle or name; sets agent_mode one). Empty clears it.

plan_first.description: An agent posts a plan a person approves before it works

need_criteria.description: Cards need acceptance criteria before an agent takes them

need_checklist.description: Cards leave this column only with every checklist item ticked (binding for agents)

next.description: The column work goes to when an agent submits (default: the next column)

return_to.description: Review columns: where Request changes sends the card (default: the column it was worked in)

lease_minutes.description: How long a claim holds without a heartbeat (2..240, default 15)

max_attempts.description: Tries before the card needs a person (1..10, default 3)

aging_days.description: Flag cards older than this many days here (0 = from the board's history)

operations.name: columns.move
operations.description: People: reorder a column.
operations.label: Move column

operations.name: columns.remove
operations.description: People: remove a column; its cards move to move_to first.
operations.label: Remove column

operations.name: labels.save
operations.description: People: add a label to a board or rename / recolour one.
operations.label: Save label

operations.name: labels.remove
operations.description: People: remove a label from the board and its cards.
operations.label: Remove label

operations.name: rules.list
operations.description: A board's rules (When, If, Then) in order, with how often each ran and why a rule was switched off; plus the triggers and actions available.
operations.label: Rules

operations.name: rules.save
operations.description: People: add or change a rule. when: enters_column (with column), created, checklist_done, approved, changes_requested, needs_attention, blocked, idle (days), due_soon (days). conditions {"priority":[1,2],"labels":["<id>"],"assignee":"person|agent|none|<member email>|<agent handle>"}. actions [{"do":"move","column":"<id>"},{"do":"assign","to":"requester|pool|<member email>|<agent handle>|"},{"do":"priority","value":1},{"do":"label","label":"<id>"},{"do":"request_review"},{"do":"block","reason":"..."},{"do":"comment","text":"..."},{"do":"archive"}]. A rule's actions never trigger other rules.
operations.label: Save rule

column.description: Column id or name (on the card's board)

operations.name: rules.remove
operations.description: People: remove a rule.
operations.label: Remove rule

operations.name: cards.list
operations.description: Cards with filters: board, column, assignee (me, none, pool (any agent), a person (email or name) or an agent (handle or name)), requester (me or a person), agent state, waiting for review, text, label, archived.
operations.label: Cards

column.description: Column id or name (on the card's board)

assignee.description: Assigned to: me, none, pool (any agent), a person (email or name) or an agent (handle or name)

requester.description: Asked for by: me or a person (email or name)

q.description: Text in the title or description

full.description: Include description, criteria, checklist and review

operations.name: cards.get
operations.description: One card in full (description, acceptance criteria, checklist, plan, question, review packet, feedback, assignee, requester, the agent on it), its column's contract, its activity (who said and did what) and its runs.
operations.label: Card

operations.name: cards.add
operations.description: Add a card. From an agent it is a PROPOSAL: it waits in Proposed until a person accepts it (at most 20 a day per agent). From a person it lands in the column given (default the first to-do column), assigned as they say (default nobody) with them as its requester; a column agents work hands it to them.
operations.label: New card

column.description: Column id or name (on the card's board)

priority.description: urgent, high, medium, low or none (or 1-4, 0 = none)

labels.description: JSON list of label names or ids, e.g. ["Bug"]

checklist.description: JSON list of checklist items, e.g. ["Draft","Check links"]

assignee.description: Assign it (people only): me, none, pool (any agent), a person (email or name) or an agent (handle or name)

position.description: Top or bottom of the column

reason.description: An agent: why you propose it

operations.name: cards.update
operations.description: Change a card's text and fields; every change is logged and can be reverted. An agent changes cards in started columns only while it works on them (work.next), and should send version.
operations.label: Change card

version.description: The card version you read; a newer card refuses the write (re-read and redo)

priority.description: urgent, high, medium, low or none (or 1-4, 0 = none)

labels.description: JSON list of label names or ids, e.g. ["Bug"]

due.description: Due date, or empty to clear

checklist.description: JSON list replacing the checklist: strings or {"text","done"}

operations.name: cards.move
operations.description: Move a card to a column (and a place in it). Entering a column agents work hands it to them and queues it. Agents cannot move cards to Done or Canceled, nor a card another agent holds, and a full column (WIP) refuses them.
operations.label: Move card

version.description: The card version you read; a newer card refuses the write (re-read and redo)

operations.name: cards.assign
operations.description: People: assign a card to a person, one agent, the pool (any agent; it queues at once in to-do and started columns) or nobody. Handing it to agents makes you its requester. Taking a card from an agent while it works on it stops that work.
operations.label: Assign card

assignee.description: Assign to: me, none, pool (any agent), a person (email or name) or an agent (handle or name)

operations.name: cards.comment
operations.description: Comment on a card (markdown). A person's comment reaches the agent working on it with its next heartbeat.
operations.label: Comment

operations.name: cards.check
operations.description: Tick or untick a checklist item (by number, id or text), reword it, add one, or (people) remove one.
operations.label: Checklist item

item.description: Item number (1 = first), id or text

add.description: Add an item with this text

operations.name: cards.block
operations.description: Flag a card blocked with a reason (it stays in its column; agents skip it).
operations.label: Flag blocked

operations.name: cards.unblock
operations.description: Clear the blocked flag.
operations.label: Unblock

operations.name: cards.archive
operations.description: People: archive cards (they leave the board; restore brings them back).
operations.label: Archive cards

cards.description: JSON list of card keys or ids

operations.name: cards.restore
operations.description: People: bring archived cards back.
operations.label: Restore cards

cards.description: JSON list of card keys or ids

operations.name: cards.delete
operations.description: People: delete a card and its activity for good.
operations.label: Delete card

operations.name: cards.accept
operations.description: People: accept a card an agent proposed (into the backlog, or the column given); you become its requester.
operations.label: Accept proposal

column.description: Column id or name (on the card's board)

operations.name: cards.answer
operations.description: People: answer an agent's question (or give the acceptance criteria a card waits for, or say how to revise a plan); the card goes back to the agent.
operations.label: Answer agent

operations.name: cards.approve_plan
operations.description: People: approve the plan an agent posted; it goes ahead.
operations.label: Approve plan

operations.name: cards.stop
operations.description: People: stop the agent on a card now; the card becomes yours until you hand it to an agent again.
operations.label: Stop agent

operations.name: cards.retry
operations.description: People: give a card that needs attention another go with its agent (or the pool); attempts start again.
operations.label: Retry

note.description: What to do differently (the agent reads it)

operations.name: review.list
operations.description: Cards waiting for a person's review, with the agent's review packet (summary, evidence, unverified, criteria) and who did the work.
operations.label: Review queue

mine.description: Only cards you asked for (and ones nobody owns)

operations.name: review.approve
operations.description: People: approve the work; the card moves on (to Done by default). Agents cannot.
operations.label: Approve

column.description: Column id or name (on the card's board)

operations.name: review.changes
operations.description: People: send the work back to the agent that did it, with what to change; it goes back to the column it was worked in.
operations.label: Request changes

reason.description: What to change (the agent reads it)

operations.name: review.reject
operations.description: People: reject the work; the card goes back to its requester.
operations.label: Reject

operations.name: work.queue
operations.description: An agent: how many cards wait for you (assigned to you or to the pool), per board, and how many you work now against your limit.
operations.label: Work waiting

operations.name: work.next
operations.description: An agent: claim ONE card for you atomically (yours or from the pool, most urgent first) and get everything to work it: the card, the board's how_we_work, the column's instructions and policy, feedback, the requester and the recent conversation (who said what), your run id and lease. No card = nothing waiting for you, or you already work your limit: then it lists your held cards and which ones a session left behind (resumable) for work.resume.
operations.label: Take next card

operations.name: work.heartbeat
operations.description: An agent: keep your lease on a card and say what you are doing now; answers with anything the team said meanwhile.
operations.label: Heartbeat

run.description: Your run id from work.next or work.resume. Always pass it: if another session took the card over, your call is refused (stale_run) instead of both working on it.

progress.description: What you are doing (one line, shown on the card)

cost.description: Cost of this stretch of work, if you track it

operations.name: work.log
operations.description: An agent: add a step to the card's live activity (thought, action, note or result); it also renews the lease.
operations.label: Log step

run.description: Your run id from work.next or work.resume. Always pass it: if another session took the card over, your call is refused (stale_run) instead of both working on it.

operations.name: work.plan
operations.description: An agent: post (or update) your plan for a card: a list of steps, each pending, doing, done or skipped. In a column that needs a plan first, the card then waits for a person to approve it.
operations.label: Post plan

run.description: Your run id from work.next or work.resume. Always pass it: if another session took the card over, your call is refused (stale_run) instead of both working on it.

steps.description: JSON list of steps: strings or {"text","status"}

operations.name: work.ask
operations.description: An agent: ask ONE clear question instead of guessing; you release the card and it waits on its requester (or anyone on the team), then comes back to you with the answer.
operations.label: Ask the team

run.description: Your run id from work.next or work.resume. Always pass it: if another session took the card over, your call is refused (stale_run) instead of both working on it.

operations.name: work.submit
operations.description: An agent: finish a card with your result and its evidence. It moves to review for people (or on to the next column agents work). Report every acceptance criterion.
operations.label: Submit work

run.description: Your run id from work.next or work.resume. Always pass it: if another session took the card over, your call is refused (stale_run) instead of both working on it.

summary.description: What you did and where the result is

evidence.description: JSON list: how you checked it (sources, tests, links)

unverified.description: JSON list: what you could not check or assumed

criteria.description: JSON list [{"text":"<criterion>","met":true,"note":"..."}] (required when the card has acceptance criteria)

cost.description: Cost of the work, if you track it

operations.name: work.return
operations.description: An agent: hand a card back to its requester with the reason (it is not agent work, out of scope, needs their judgment, access or budget).
operations.label: Hand back

run.description: Your run id from work.next or work.resume. Always pass it: if another session took the card over, your call is refused (stale_run) instead of both working on it.

operations.name: work.fail
operations.description: An agent: you tried and could not finish; the card is retried (a pool card by any agent) until the column's max attempts, then needs a person.
operations.label: Report failure

run.description: Your run id from work.next or work.resume. Always pass it: if another session took the card over, your call is refused (stale_run) instead of both working on it.

operations.name: work.resume
operations.description: An agent: take over a card of yours a previous session left behind (still marked working but nobody checked in for 1.5 heartbeat intervals). work.next lists such cards as resumable when you are at your limit. Returns the same as work.next with a new run; a card another session is still working is refused (code active), and a card another agent holds is not yours (not_yours).
operations.label: Take over

operations.name: work.release
operations.description: An agent: let go of a card without finishing (it goes back to the queue; a pool card back to the pool).
operations.label: Release

run.description: Your run id from work.next or work.resume. Always pass it: if another session took the card over, your call is refused (stale_run) instead of both working on it.

operations.name: inbox.list
operations.description: What needs the caller (reviews, questions, cards needing attention, proposals, blocked, overdue): their own cards (asked for by them, assigned to them, or owned by nobody) or everyone's; and what the others did since they last looked.
operations.label: Inbox

since.description: Updates after this time (default: since you last looked)

operations.name: inbox.seen
operations.description: The person looked at the updates.
operations.label: Mark seen

operations.name: insights.flow
operations.description: Flow of work over a window: WIP by column, aging work in progress, cycle times with 50/85/95th percentiles, weekly throughput, cumulative flow, review wait and first-pass approval, split by agents and people, and each agent's report card (runs, approval and first-pass rates, questions, failures, expiries, median run time).
operations.label: Flow

operations.name: activity.list
operations.description: The activity log, newest first: every change with who made it (a person, an agent, a rule, the board), before and after, the run, and whether it can be reverted.
operations.label: Activity

who.description: One actor: me, a member (email or name) or an agent (handle)

operations.name: activity.revert
operations.description: People: revert changes (one event, several, or everything one agent run changed).
operations.label: Revert

operations.name: activity.undo
operations.description: The person: undo your own last change (within 30 minutes).
operations.label: Undo
